items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: The first job I played, I played with a piano player and uh, that was the first time I ever played on a job, the first time, just with a piano player.

ctx.x: No, I don't think so because I don't know. August Linwall's wife is the Gabriel's, yes. They came from up, stay around Thibodeau or something like that. Do you remember where your, what was your very first job that you played? Do you remember that you ever got paid for? Was there even with any other band when you started out?
The first job I played, I played with a piano player and uh, that was the first time I ever played on a job, the first time, just with a piano player. You remember that job?
